name: Zoo world — a closed taxonomy
description: A small closed zoology authored as facts plus Horn rules: four named animals (Rex the dog, Tom the cat, Moby the whale, Pip the sparrow) and a subsumption spine — dog/cat/whale ⊑ mammal, sparrow ⊑ bird, mammal ⊑ warm-blooded, bird ⊑ warm-blooded. Materialized (forward-chained) it derives every animal's kind and warmth. As a game board: 'every mammal is warm-blooded' is a theorem of this world (holds); 'every warm-blooded thing is a mammal' is refuted by Pip the sparrow (fails). Closed-world: an unrecorded trait counts as absent.
